spec.title: CI/CD cost
spec.description: Estimated CodeBuild and CodePipeline cost of runs started in the range, priced at the AWS list price in force when each ran, vs the previous period.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_pipelines AS (
  SELECT x.*,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(sc.production_pattern, '') = '' THEN 'Not set'
         WHEN (SELECT cp.environment FROM _tool_aws_pipeline_executions e1
               JOIN cicd_pipelines cp ON cp.id = CONCAT('aws:AwsPipelineExecution:', e1.connection_id, ':', e1.execution_id)
               WHERE e1.connection_id = x.connection_id AND e1.pipeline_arn = x.arn LIMIT 1) = 'PRODUCTION' THEN 'Production'
         ELSE 'Non-production' END AS env
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.connection_id, p.arn, p.name, p.region, p.url, p.scope_config_id
    FROM project_mapping pm
    JOIN _tool_aws_pipelines p ON pm.row_id = CONCAT('aws:AwsPipeline:', p.connection_id, ':', p.arn)
    WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
  ) x
  LEFT JOIN _tool_aws_scope_configs sc ON sc.id = x.scope_config_id
),
runs AS (

  JOIN _tool_aws_codebuild_builds b ON b.connection_id = a.connection_id AND b.build_id = a.external_execution_id

)

UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeTo() AS time, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN run_start >= $__timeFrom() THEN cost END), 2), 0) AS value FROM costrows

  SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31 THEN period_start + INTERVAL 1 DAY WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN period_start + INTERVAL 7 DAY ELSE period_start + INTERVAL 1 MONTH END FROM periods WHERE CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31 THEN period_start + INTERVAL 1 DAY WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN period_start + INTERVAL 7 DAY ELSE period_start + INTERVAL 1 MONTH END < $__timeTo()
),

  SELECT x.*,

         WHEN (SELECT cp.environment FROM _tool_aws_pipeline_executions e1

  SELECT a.pipeline, a.execution_id, r.status, a.run_start, 'CodeBuild', b.billed_minutes, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, b.start_time, b.end_time),
    b.estimated_cost_usd, a.stage_name, a.action_name, b.project_name, a.status
  FROM actions a
  JOIN runs r ON r.connection_id = a.connection_id AND r.execution_id = a.execution_id
  JOIN _tool_aws_codebuild_builds b ON b.connection_id = a.connection_id AND b.build_id = a.external_execution_id
  WHERE a.provider = 'CodeBuild'
),
computed AS (
  SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31 THEN DATE(run_start) WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN DATE_SUB(DATE(run_start), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(run_start) DAY) ELSE DATE_FORMAT(run_start, '%Y-%m-01') END AS DATE) AS period_start, SUM(cost) AS v FROM costrows GROUP BY 1
),
ce AS (
  SELECT c.date, c.service, c.amount FROM _tool_aws_cost_daily c JOIN conn_scope s ON s.connection_id = c.connection_id
  WHERE c.metric = 'UnblendedCost' AND c.date >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND c.date < $__timeTo()
),
billed AS (
  SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31 THEN DATE(date) WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY) ELSE DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01') END AS DATE) AS period_start, SUM(amount) AS v FROM ce WHERE service IN ('CodeBuild', 'AWS CodeBuild', 'AWS CodePipeline') GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT CAST(GREATEST(p.period_start, $__timeFrom()) AS DATETIME) AS time, COALESCE(c.v, 0) AS "Estimated by DevLake",
  CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ce) > 0 THEN COALESCE(b.v, 0) END AS "Billed (Cost Explorer)"
FROM periods p LEFT JOIN computed c ON c.period_start = p.period_start LEFT JOIN billed b ON b.period_start = p.period_start
ORDER BY p.period_start

spec.title: Prices in force
spec.description: The CodeBuild and CodePipeline list prices DevLake uses for the regions of the selected projects' pipelines, with the previous price when AWS published a change. Prices are refreshed at most once a day.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_pipelines AS (
  SELECT x.*,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(sc.production_pattern, '') = '' THEN 'Not set'
         WHEN (SELECT cp.environment FROM _tool_aws_pipeline_executions e1
               JOIN cicd_pipelines cp ON cp.id = CONCAT('aws:AwsPipelineExecution:', e1.connection_id, ':', e1.execution_id)
               WHERE e1.connection_id = x.connection_id AND e1.pipeline_arn = x.arn LIMIT 1) = 'PRODUCTION' THEN 'Production'
         ELSE 'Non-production' END AS env
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.connection_id, p.arn, p.name, p.region, p.url, p.scope_config_id
    FROM project_mapping pm
    JOIN _tool_aws_pipelines p ON pm.row_id = CONCAT('aws:AwsPipeline:', p.connection_id, ':', p.arn)
    WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
  ) x
  LEFT JOIN _tool_aws_scope_configs sc ON sc.id = x.scope_config_id
),
regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT region FROM scoped_pipelines
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT pr.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pr.region, pr.usage_type ORDER BY pr.publication_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM _tool_aws_prices pr JOIN regions r ON r.region = pr.region
)
SELECT c.region AS Region, c.usage_type AS "Usage type", c.unit AS Unit, c.price_usd AS Price, c.publication_date AS "Published",
  p.price_usd AS "Previous price", p.publication_date AS "Previous published"
FROM ordered c LEFT JOIN ordered p ON p.region = c.region AND p.usage_type = c.usage_type AND p.rn = 2
WHERE c.rn = 1
ORDER BY c.region, c.usage_type
